description: Emotis getting their ducks and chickens and geese in a row!

name: Cozy Christmas 2.0
description: Emotis are getting into the holiday spirits! This version of the Cozy Christmas design features some holly jolly emotis on a white & green striped background.

name: Holly Jolly Textiles
description: There's no better way to spread festive cheer than with this holly jolly holiday washi tape! A great design for layering and decorating Christmas cards!

name: Winter Doodles
description: A roll of cute doodles that scream winter! I hope to get around to designing the other seaasons soon!

name: Chinese Zodiac Emotis
description: I wanted our first zodiac washi to be on a pink background so that it could match more spreads! I do hope to release a bright red version in the future :)

name: Lunar Skies
description: Sweet emotis playing among the lunar sky! A perfect compliment to a Lunar New Year spread.

name: Spooky Bookshelf
description: Oh no! This abandoned bookshelf has been overrun by mischievous emotis. Make sure to dust the books and check for any cobwebs...

name: Midnight Magic
description: A bold addition to our galaxy series! Most emotis are nocturnal creatures...

name: Stunning Sunrise
description: A stunning addition to our galaxy series! This washi tape captures the serene moment before the day starts.

name: Sunset Shimmer
description: A bold galaxy design to capture the breathtaking sunsets we get to see each day.

name: Desk Clutter
description: A snapshot of a stationery nerd's desk! Books, journals, pens and washi tapes scattered throughout. Nevermind the emotis being bothersome, as usual...

name: Pens & Pencils
description: A must-have for any stationery lover! Vertical washis are great to use for time-blocking or as dividers on a page.

name: Working Time 3.0
description: These emotis look a bit stressed! The perfect roll to mark productive work days.

name: Stitch & Friends 2.0
description: We have gotten so many requests over the years to bring back these cuties! Now on a pale blue background.

name: Opalescent Oceans
description: A spin-off of the The Four Biomes washi! This roll is littered with critters and it matches our Just Keep Swimming collection

name: A Rainbow Neighbourhood
description: An extra special roll as all proceeds will be donated to Rainbow Railroad as part of our annual Pride month fundraiser! We have previously donated to RR but it was several years ago and I think we can raise a bit more this time! RR is a non-profit organization that works to bring LGBTQIA+ folks in imminent danger to safety.

name: Whimsical Woods
description: A spin-off of the The Four Biomes washi! This roll is littered with critters and it matches our Out of the Woods collection perfectly!

name: Little Sprouts
description: These emotis are sprouting just in time for spring & summer! Add a touch of cuteness to the bottom of your planner pages, or to mark gardening activities!

name: Mountains & Meadows 2.0
description: The first version is a customer favourite so I'm super pleased to bring out a second version! Differences are: the sky is white instead of blue, the scenery has been extended, no foil, and I used a warmer colour palette. You might also find an emoti lurking throughout the roll...

name: Fruity Fun
description: The Fruits & Veggies washi from our 2022 advent is one of my favourites so I had to do a fruits spin-off! All of the fruits are arranged in rainbow order, stamped on a fun warm yellow that just screams summer!

name: Shopping Spree
description: If you are visiting this site, this washi tape probably applies to you 😉 Featuring emotis grocery shopping, making online purchases, and splurging on some treats!

name: Planning Time 2.0
description: Our Planning Time washi series is one of our most loved designs! Perfect for any planner & stationery lovers. Let us know what colours we should do next!

name: Subtle Storm
description: Continuing our galaxy series, we have this muted light grey version! I think this can be used both for happy days and gloomy days.

name: Classic Vertical Emotis
description: I don't use vertical washi tapes too often, but they come in handy as dividers or for time-blocking!

name: Classic Emotis 2.0
description: A simple emoti design that matches any spread. These happy guys always make me smile :)

name: Twinkle Twinkle Glitter
description: A reproduction from 2020, but on a special glitter material! This glitter doesn't shed and it has a sandy texture.

name: Winnie & Friends 1.1
description: While this version has slight changes from 1.0 released in 2020, I didn't feel it was enough to be considered 2.0.

name: Breaking News
description: This washi tape is perfect for layering! Last chance to grab this new issue of TCMC TIMES!

name: Happy Hobbies
description: If your hobby is collecting hobbies, this washi is perfect for you! Art, gaming, spending time outdoors--emotis do it all!

name: Planner Supplies 2.0
description: [incorrect image] A staple in any stationery lover's collection! Featuring doodles of some popular planners, notebooks, pens, and stationery goodies with emotis scattered throughout.

name: Floral Forest 2.0
description: [incorrect image] A whimsical roll of floral emoti washi tape! The background is a really pale purple to compliment the pink of our first version. This roll is dedicated to the SGS Orlando Planner Conference.

name: Ice Town
description: A gorgeous scenery of a secluded ice town. Emotis skating about and living their peaceful lives... until... you see it in person... ;)

name: Winter Critters 2.0
description: [incorrect image] The second in our seasonal series! A beautiful pale blue with little foiled snowflake detailing.

name: Pumpkin Patch
description: There seems to be another creature trying to blend in with the emotis... The perfect washi to match any autumnal spread!

name: Tea Time 2.0
description: [incorrect image] Green, black, herbal--so many kinds of tea! This roll features some tea time emotis, ready to dip some biscuits.

name: Coffee Time 2.0
description: [incorrect image] The tired emoti is such a mood! This is the perfect washi for a coffee enthusiast, or just someone who needs a strong cup to get through the day.

name: Ode To Van Gogh
description: Bring Van Gogh's famous Starry Night to your planner pages with this gorgeous, sparkly washi! While this cartoonized version does not do the original justice, you will surely get a magical feeling every time your planner pages catches the light.

name: Ode To Monet
description: Feel like you are outside on a foggy day, observing the gorgeous lilies with each passing season. A tribute to Monet's fascination with his water lilies.

name: Ode To Hokusai
description: Fitting with the rest of the Master Artists collection, "The Great Wave off Kanagawa" is such an influential piece that is thought to have influenced Vincent Van Gogh and Claude Monet. It has also been said to be "possibly the most reproduced image in the history of all art", and this washi tape has been added to that list.

name: Ode To Da Vinci
description: A Renaissance man, I wanted to capture the brilliance of Leonardo Da Vinci beyond his art. This pattern is a stylized compilation of notes and sketches from Da Vinci's tattered notebooks.

name: Love Boldly
description: As the name suggestions, these emotis aren't afraid to be BOLD. A black background to contrast against the gorgeous holo foiled emoti heads and bright hearts.

name: Little Chores 2.0
description: One of our most popular designs is back on a gorgeous purple-to-blue background. Reminds me of mermaid colours! Use this fun washi to make not-so-fun chores a bit more bearable.

name: Sunset Shimmer 2.0
description: A BOLD addition to our galaxy series! Bringing back sunset shimmer, but with gorgeous saturated pinks, corals and yellows.

name: Classic Animal Onesies 2.0
description: A staple for any planner! This design is a revamp from our first ever preorder event back in 2018! The artwork has been updated and for this version, the colours are much more muted. This is adorable by itself to match any planner spread, but also great if you want to unleash your creativity by colouring on the washi!

name: In The Kitchen
description: The start of a new room series! These emotis are chefing it up in the kitchen and baking up delicious treats. How precious are the little kitchen linens???

name: Concrete Jungle
description: An extra magical roll of a cityscape! When designing this washi tape, I was contemplating what foil would go with this and nothing seemed right. A city at night is typically a salad of different coloured lights! This is where the duo-foiled idea came about and I am so excited for you to experience this magic in person.

name: Down Days
description: These emotis aren't having the best day... Initially, I made the background a grey to match the mood of this theme. I then decided to switch it out for a muted rainbow because we could all use a bit of rainbow when we are having a down day!

name: Potato Party
description: If you understand this roll, I love you. No further explanations needed.

name: Reading & Resting
description: This roll gives me all the autumnal feels! Cozy-up with a book, some plants, and read away! Can you spot the little reading buddy?

name: A Blossoming Neighbourhood
description: An addition to our neighbourhood series! This town is blossoming with gorgeous sakura. Perfect for spring, but if you are a pink lover like me, I will be using this all year!

name: Hospital Heroes
description: Dedicated to all of our healthcare workers who keep the world healthy! Perfect for anyone working in the medical field, or for patients on the other side of the coin who may go for check-ups. Another idea is using this washi to mark watching medical shows!

name: Muted Galaxy
description: Another addition to our galaxy series! Similar to our popular Rainbow Retrograde variation, this pastel muted rainbow is so gorgeous for any spread.

name: Lucky Charms
description: Start your morning off right with cereal, milk, rainbows, emotis, and a little bit of luck! This adorable washi tape is perfect to brighten up any planner spread and add a touch of magic.

name: Planner Supplies
description: A staple in any stationery lover's collection! Featuring doodles of some popular planners, notebooks, pens, and stationery goodies with emotis scattered throughout.

name: Evening Fog Emoti Heads
description: A beautiful muted blue to match our Evening Routine washi.

name: Evening Routine
description: They say a relaxing evening routine sets you up for a successful tomorrow... and these Emotis definitely know how to wind down for the day!

name: Fruits & Veggies
description: The perfect washi to mark spring gardening, or a start to incorporating more plants into your meals!

name: Sweet Treats
description: Emotis definitely have a sweet tooth. Oreos, cookies, brownies--they love it all! The foil background is a fun sprinkle mix.

name: Morning Routine
description: Start your day off with some adorable emotis! That alarm clock emoti is my spirit animal... Perfect to mark the start of a new week!

name: The Four Biomes
description: Speaking personally, The Four Biomes collection is probably the favourite collection I have ever worked on artistically. Capturing all things beautiful and cute in nature, each biome tells a story by itself and as a group. A special note about this washi, it has both frosty silver and regular silver foil!

name: Cozy Christmas
description: A new Christmas washi is in town! The sweetest washi to accompany your festive Christmas spreads this holiday season. Featuring adorable emotis on a light checkered background.

name: Cozy Halloween
description: A new Halloween washi is in town! Featuring some adorable emotis in costume and ready for a cozy night in. The medium-toned grey background is perfect to match either pastel or dark and spooky Halloween spreads--completely up to you!

name: Cozy Cat Doodles
description: WonderPens x TheCoffeeMonsterzCo A special shout out to Jon & Liz's adorable kitties named Chicken and Tuna!

name: Fountain Pen Doodles
description: WonderPens x TheCoffeeMonsterzCo A fountain pen is a tool for the fountain of expression! This washi tape is for all you fountain pen lovers!

name: Ink Bottle Doodles
description: WonderPens x TheCoffeeMonsterz Co Is there such thing as too many ink bottles? Yeah, I didn't think so either! A cute washi tape celebrating ink bottles of all sizes!

name: Fountain Pen Emotis
description: WonderPens x TheCoffeeMonsterzCo I am so excited for this washi tape collaboration with the fabulous WonderPens! It is about time we combine our love for planners & stationery with the world of fountain pens. These emotis are definitely unleashing their imagination one stroke at a time!

name: Rainbow Emoti Heads
description: Brighten-up any planner or journaling page with this rainbow washi tape! Featuring our adorable emoti heads in all sorts of moods~

name: Birthday Bash Emotis
description: A fun and colourful washi tape to mark birthday celebrations!

name: Self Care 2.0
description: A revamp of our self care washi tapes! The background is a soft, muted purple that fades towards the bottom. Perfect to mark relaxing nights in!

name: Rainbow Animal Onesies 2.0
description: One of our most popular washi tapes ever is the rainbow animal onesies! Now back with revamped artwork and a pastel rainbow background!

name: Fitness Fun
description: A fun washi to get motivated! How adorable is that little peachy butt? This roll features all sorts of fitness activities from yoga to sports to running and weights!

name: The Four Seasons
description: Inspired by the brilliant Italian composer Antonio Vivaldi, this gorgeous continuous scenery washi features the beauties of each season.

name: Bills & Budgeting
description: Bills and budgeting aren't really fun things to deal with.... but these emotis look like they're having a blast! Fun fact: this is our first truly green washi tape!

name: Café Time
description: An adorable washi to mark people watching at a cafe, getting work done, or meeting-up with freinds! The colour of this washi reminds me of a milky cup of coffee~

name: Affirmations
description: A great way to remind yourself each day how awesome you are! Don't let anyone tell you otherwise. This washi is a pale yellow with little white spots and foiled doodles.

name: Princess Party 2.0
description: This was a highly requested washi tape to bring back. We updated the princess art and added a few additions. Can you spot them? Gorgeous pink foil on a cotton candy background.

name: Classic Emotis
description: Probably our most simple design, but I think it's the most versatile! This washi tape sparked a lot of creativity in our Facebook group when members started doodling little outfits, colouring in the background, and turning the emotis into characters just with some markers!

name: Potion Blue Emoti Heads
description: Another installment of our emoti head washi series! This time, a gorgeous teal colour to match our 6 year anniversary theme.

name: Magic Forest
description: Do you dare to walk through the Magic Forest? Careful... you might encounter some emotis that will overpower you with cuteness! As part of our Find Magic In The Ordinary theme for our 6 year anniversary event! Quite literally a magical roll with icy blue foil detailing.

name: Sleepy Doodles
description: How adorable are these little doodles? Perfect for marking a rest day. This roll features a jumping sheep, alarm clock, drooling emoti, bed time story, a cute pillow, clouds, a teddy bear emoti, and some magical stars.

name: Sleepy Time Emotis
description: A sweet roll of sleepy time emotis! Some adorable critters on a pastel pink, purple, and blue background finished off with silver foil detailing.

name: Coffee Time
description: How is it that we have gone 5+ years without releasing a coffee themed washi? This adorable roll features nine of our coffee time emotis on a layered background--meant to resemble the beautiful layers when cream hits the espresso! Finished off with a gorgeous coffee bean brown foil detailing and a hidden word in the background.

name: Tea Time
description: So many different types of teas! Which is your favourite? This adorable roll features nine of our tea time emotis on a milky tea-coloured background. Finished off with a gorgeous matcha green foil detailing and a hidden word in the background.

name: A Spooky Neighbourhood
description: The third installment of our neighbourhood series... this time, it's SPOOKY! Filled with tombstones, dead trees, and cobwebs, what is there not to love? The silver foil detailing pops like no other against the dark night sky.

name: Planner Land
description: Inspired by our Facebook group banner, this thicker 18mm washi is littered with adorable stationery details! Perfect for any planner lovers. Would you want to live in Planner Land?

name: Vertical Emoti Heads
description: Our first vertical washi design! This is perfect as decorative borders or making bulleted lists. The 7mm width is not too thin to ensure the design is still visible, but not too thick that it gets in the way of your writing!

name: Working Emotis 2.0
description: [incorrect image] Oh no, these emotis are stressed from work! A gloomier design for a week when you're overwhelmed with things to do...

name: Working Emotis
description: Oh no, these emotis are stressed from work! A gloomier design for a week when you're overwhelmed with things to do...

name: Book Nerd 2.0
description: This 2.0 topped the 1.0 version in my opinion! A mostly greyscale design with touches of muted pastels. The background is meant to resemble a newspaper clipping!

name: Travel Time
description: These emotis are ready to vacation around the world! The background is a beautiful perwinkle-to-purple gradient with a faint white grid to look like a map!

name: Summer Critters
description: Are cows and elephants found on beaches?! Haha this is the final installment of our seasonal critters series! The layered background colours are meant to resemble the beach.

name: Mountains & Meadows
description: Inspired by the beautiful mountains here in British Columbia, this scenery washi is like a breath of fresh air! Featuring little floral doodles and cloud detailing.

name: Winnie & Friends 2.0
description: A lovely complement to the first version, this Winnie the Pooh pattern is on a buttery yellow background.

name: Fall Critters 2.0
description: A revamped version of our fall critters design from over 2 years ago! With new art and on a peachy beige backing, this washi is perfect for any autumnal spread.

name: Floral Forest
description: Fun fact, this design was added 2 hours prior to my preorder announcement... talk about last minute! But this is certainly one of my favourite designs for its simplicity.

name: Snail Mail Doodles 2.0
description: The second version of our Snail Mail Doodles washi is on a deep, yellow-ish orange background. It's reminiscent of the kraft envelope we use to ship out lettermail orders!

name: Planning Time
description: This is the perfect washi for any planner or stationery lover! Featuring an emoti with happy mail, pencil, stickers, planner, and of course washi tapes. The background is a pale pink.

name: Christmas Doodles
description: DAY 12: Some fun doodles that are perfect to decorate holiday cards and journal spreads!

name: Christmas Emotis
description: DAY 11: The most festive washi tape! There exists a misfit version with silver foil.

name: Book Nerd
description: DAY 9: I cant think of a more perfect washi for book worms! There is a faint message written in the background... can you make it out?!

name: Jack Frost Emotis
description: DAY 7: A perfect wintery blue fading into a light purple. There exists a misfit version with red foil.

name: Rainbow Retrograde
description: DAY 6: The fourth edition of our galaxy series! A beautiful pastel rainbow gradient background.

name: Snail Mail Doodles
description: DAY 5: The perfect washi to use on penpal letters or sending happy mail to your planner friends~

name: Snowy Neighbourhood
description: DAY 3: The second in our neighbourhood series. Do you spy a silly emoti hiding on the roll? ;)

name: Winter Critters Emoti Heads
description: DAY 2: A thinner version of our Winter Critters emoti washi tape!

name: Winter Emotis
description: DAY 1: Brrr a chilly roll! These adorable emotis are embracing their winter gear!

name: Sunshine Daisies
description: Part of my 20th birthday bundle. A little Harry Potter reference :)

name: Little Chores
description: Part of my 20th birthday bundle. A pretty light blue fading into a white background featuring emotis tackling their daily chores!

name: Winnie & Friends Onesie Heads
description: A skinny version of our much-loved Winnie & Friends tape! How adorable are these little onesie heads?!

name: Interstellar
description: The third in our galaxy series. A mix of mid-tone purples, blues and hints of pink!

name: Dark Side
description: A Star Wars-inspired washi tape. A deep blue background with bits of navy and black.

name: Spring Critters
description: The third installment of our seasonal series! Featuring a selection of the sweetest Spring critters ... except Kermit looks a bit cheeky!

name: Friendly Neighborhood
description: The first in our neighbourhood series! A fun continuous pattern of an emoti town featuring houses, trees, and little emoti residents.

name: Vampy Villains
description: A dark, vampy counterpart to our Princess Party washi. There are little foiled doodle detailing in the background.

name: Pink Emoti Heads
description: Part of our 4 year anniversary bundle! The perfect shade of powder pink as the second in our Emoti Heads washi tape collection.

name: Self-Care Emotis
description: Part of our 4 year anniversary bundle! A beautiful washi tape as a reminder to treat yourself!

name: Mint Emoti Heads
description: A revamped version of our original mint washi tape and the first of our Emoti Heads washi tape series! This is a 'permanent' roll that gets restocked repeatedly every few months so be on the lookout!

name: Classic Animal Onesies
description: We introduced our first 10mm washi line on Black Friday! A thinner version of our Classic Animal Onesies washi tape.

name: Sunset Shimmer
description: The second in our galaxy series! The background is a beautiful mix of pale pinks, oranges, peaches and yellows.

name: Stitch & Friends
description: Foil is a pretty blue colour that matches scrump! The letters OHANA are sprinkled in the background as a fun detail.

name: Princess Party
description: I definitely want to bring back a revamped version one day! This roll features 15 princesses on a fun, colourful gradient background.

name: Winter Critters
description: The second in our seasonal series! A beautiful pale blue with little foiled snowflake detailing.

name: Fall Critters
description: The beginning of our seasonal series! A beautiful orange to peach gradient with little foiled leaf detailing.

name: Rainbow Onesies
description: A super colourful roll for my 19th birthday sale event! Just looking at this roll makes me super happy :) The background is a perfect mid-tone Rainbow gradient.

name: Twinkle Twinkle
description: The beginning of our galaxy series! The background is a soft blend of blues, pinks, purples and white. Littered with foiled stars, clouds, and magical specks!

name: Lavender Gradient Emotis
description: Dabbling into some non-traditional foil colours! This simple design matches so many of my purple/pink spreads so I use it very often!

name: Winnie & Friends
description: Taking our brand growth into account, I believe this is our bestselling washi tape! Rightfully so as Winnie the Pooh holds a very special place in my childhood.

name: Anniversary Pink Onesies
description: Our first foiled washi tape! This roll was originally released for our anniversary event, then later brought back for a washi preorder.

name: Winter Mint Emotis
description: A beautiful blueish colour to compliment Powder Pink! This colour won second place in our preorder poll.

name: Classic Animal Onesies
description: The first animal onesie washi tape! We had a poll on the Facebook group at the time to vote on the preorder designs, and this pattern won first place by a landslide!

name: Powder Pink Emotis
description: The first in our emoti washi series! This roll was originally released for my 18th birthday, then later brought back for (our first) washi preorder.

name: OG Mint Emoti Heads
description: Our first ever washi tape! This is a rare one to come across as we produced only around 100. The background is a pale mint with white polka dots.
